dedupe_keys.name: oman environment authority open data environmental licence statistics and permit datasets

description: The Environment Authority of Oman, which took over from the Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs, runs an open data section with a dataset index, published statistics, e-services data, a list of registered environmental impact assessment consultants and an Environmental Assessment and Permits data centre. The permits dataset read on 2026-09-29 is titled Environment Licenses Issued through MOCI Invest Easy: statistics of environmental licences issued from 2017 to 2022 after the permit system was integrated with the commerce ministry's Invest Easy portal, issued August 2023 by the Environmental Assessment and Permits Center, with a stated next release of March 2024 and a public download counter. Coverage: national, Oman, licences by year and activity. Format and access: free web tables with export on eservices.ea.gov.om; a request form covers data not published. Licence: the page links Oman's Government Open Licence. Caveats: the permits series ends in 2022 and the promised 2024 update was not seen; the counts are licences issued, not facility locations or emissions. Simulation uses: context on industrial and infrastructure development activity for planning and environmental risk screening. Related records: compare with Serbia's energy permits register (data-serbia-mre-energy-permits-register) and Oman's telecom open data (data-tra-oman-telecom-open-data).
